component.name: Paper Cut
component.summary: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door, native

description.p: Paper Cut plays Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door natively, from your own disc image of the Japanese, US or European release. It includes no game data.
Widescreen, high frame rates, higher resolutions, controllers of every kind, mods, save sync through any folder, and settings in the game's own Start menu.
